shared_elements: isolated motifs on an otherwise blank rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, linear, outline-based motifs set directly on bare rock, including profile figures and long sweeping curved lines, but nothing more specific is shared. A is a dense, crowded panel dominated by crewed boats with rows of stroke-figures, stick-limbed humans and a long vertical file of dots, whereas B shows a single large sparse quadruped-like creature in profile with an angular sign and a lone meandering line, so the subject matter and compositional density are quite different.
